title: Broker Contract Provision — Late Pickups on RideLink Trips
content:
This provision of the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation broker contract defines a late pickup on a RideLink trip and the record an alternative ride rests on.

**In force.** A pickup more than the level's late threshold after the end of the pickup window is a late pickup. The alternative ride is reimbursed only where a late pickup record exists for the same trip number and leg; a member who left before the late threshold was reached is not reimbursed.

**No longer in force.** The clause under which the member may then take an alternative ride and be reimbursed its receipted cost up to the level's alternative-ride maximum, as a late-pickup alternative reimbursement, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for alternative-ride reimbursement.

## Applying the definition

*Hypothetical, a level with a 15-minute pickup window and a 30-minute late threshold, scheduled pickup 14:00:* the window ends at 14:15. A pickup at 14:45 is exactly 30 minutes past the end of the window and is not a late pickup; a pickup at 14:46 is.

| Hypothetical record position | Alternative ride reimbursable under this provision |
|---|---|
| A late pickup record exists for the same trip number and the same leg | Yes, the record condition is met |
| A late pickup record exists only for the other leg of the same trip | No |
| The member left before the late threshold was reached | No |

superseded_clauses: the member may then take an alternative ride and be reimbursed its receipted cost up to late_pickup_alt_reimbursement_max_usd as a late_pickup_alternative reimbursement
